title: 360 Security Technology was reported to have developed an AI cybersecurity system
summary: On 2026-06-27, linked reporting described 360 Security Technology as developing an AI system for vulnerability discovery and automated defensive-security work. This represents a material step in the company's AI cybersecurity product development, although the linked evidence alone does not establish the system's exact name, availability, or technical performance.
